in_hebrew.name: Tabbatha
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tabbatha הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek 'Tabbatha', meaning 'Tabernacle of Grace'. In the Bible, a tabernacle was a portable shrine where God's presence dwelt. A name symbolizing the shelter and protection of God's love.

in_greek.name: Tabbatha
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Graceful Tabernacle
in_greek.long_meaning: Tabbatha είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek 'Tabbatha', meaning 'Tabernacle of Grace'. In the Bible, a tabernacle was a portable shrine where God's presence dwelt. A name symbolizing the shelter and protection of God's love.

In the Bible, a tabernacle was a portable shrine where God's presence dwelt. A name symbolizing the shelter and protection of God's love.
